scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix services/course-catalog-service
scripts.dev: concurrently --names frontend,gateway,auth,catalog --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,yellow,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix gateway run dev" "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/course-catalog-service run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently --names gateway,auth,catalog --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,green "npm --prefix gateway run dev" "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/course-catalog-service run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix gateway run build && npm --prefix auth-service run build && npm --prefix services/course-catalog-service run build
